scenes.title: Fleet, drivers and trips
scenes.subtitle: Your own cars, dispatched from the CRM
scenes.narration: Many agencies run their own cars. Vehicles, drivers and trips are managed right next to the bookings they serve.
The fleet dashboard shows trips running today, cars that are free, and anything that needs attention.
Each vehicle keeps its documents with expiry dates, and a service history with the odometer reading.
Drivers have their licence and documents on file, and a rating after each trip so you know who your best people are.
Dispatch a trip: pick the car and the driver, the pickup and drop, and the time. The distance and the fare are estimated for you.
On the trip, add costs like tolls and parking as they happen, and when it is done, turn it into an invoice.
Fleet rate cards price trips by vehicle type and trip type: per kilometre, minimum distance, driver allowance and night charges.
Insurance, permits and licences that are about to expire are flagged here, and the check runs on its own every day.
Two automations help operations: one lines up a car and a driver for every arriving traveller, the other asks for feedback when a trip is completed.

scenes.headline: Your fleet, in step with your bookings.
